sentences.text: Shri Pramod Kumar Sharma, learned counsel for the appellant  Dr. Anjali Gyanani, learned Public Prosecutor   respondent/State.

Per Justice Deepak Kumar Agarwal:
IA.No.13434/2023, 1st application u/Sec. 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant- Jaswant @ Karua.
This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 23.2.2022 passed by the Special Judge, Gwalior, in ST No.386/2018, whereby appellant has been convicted under Section 366A of IPC and Sections 5g/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo 5 years RI with fine of Rs.500/- and 20 years RI with fine of Rs.500/- respectively.
Prosecution case in brief is that on 8.7.2018 Namita, Team Member of Railway Child-line Bhopal lodged a written report to SHO, police Station GRP Bhopal to the effect that on 6.7.2018 on plateform No.1, Railway Station, Bhopal, towards Beena end near water cooler SOODAN PRASAD prosecutrix along with her friend Bhola Jatav aged 14 years was found.
IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH AT GWALIOR

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH AT GWALIOR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
At that time,
prosecutrix told her name as Golu Jatav and introduced herself as a boy.
On enquiry from her family members, it came out that she is a girl.
The prosecutrix informed that Bhola Jatav has committed rape with her on 4.7.2018 at Gallamandi, near Sabji Mandi, Gwalior, in a dilapidated house.
Beside that, Jaswant and Suraj have also committed rape with her one month ago at the same house.
On the said report, crime No.251/2018 was registered at GRP Bhopal under Section 376(d) and Section 5(d)(e)/6 of the POCSO Act.

Later on, matter was transferred to police Station Jaswant @ Karuaa vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6398084/
1 Janakganj, Gwalior where crime No.492/2018 was registered for the aforesaid offices.

entities.text: police Station Jaswant @ Karuaa vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After investigation, charge-sheet was filed.
After trial, appellant has been convicted & sentenced as aforesaid.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that prosecutrix (PW-3) has stated in para 8 of her cross-examination that appellant Jaswant has not committed any wrong with her.
DNA report is also not conclusive.

During trial, appellant remained in custody for 1320 days and and thereafter from the date of judgment i.e.
23.2.2022 he is in custody, thus he has already suffered more than 5 years incarceration.
He has a good case on merits.
Final hearing of the appeal will take time.
On such IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH AT GWALIOR premises, learned counsel for the appellant prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting anything on the merits of the case, IA.No.13434/2023 is allowed and it is directed that jail sentence of appellant - Jaswant @ Karua will remain under suspension subject to verification that the amount of fine has been deposited, on appellant's furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 18th December, 2023 and thereafter on such further dates as may be fixed by the office of this Court in this regard till disposal of the appeal.
C.c. as per rules.

(Rohit Arya) (Deepak Kumar Agarwa  Judge Judge  ms/-
